name: closing-call-to-action-section
purpose: The last ask at the end of a landing page, followed by a hatched closing frame with no rules of its own, because the site footer under it opens with one. It is a page section — the site places it from a `{ _id: 'closing-call-to-action-section', props }` entry and binds `props` straight onto it — and it composes `module`, `call-to-action`, `button`, `registration-frame` and `texture`. `variant` picks the layout only: `panel` (the default) sets the copy and its actions on one surface, over a short closing frame; `primary` is the loud close, one centred ask on the canvas under a pixelated texture whose waves keep travelling, over a tall closing frame. Both take the same copy, the same two actions and an optional copyable shell `command` set before the actions. `frame` draws the closing frame alone, with no ask: the close of a page whose last band already carries its own action. `hatch` turns the closing frame off when another closing band stacks directly below and draws the shared one (`site-page` sets it for stacked closings). In `primary`, `audiences` turns the ask into a switch between ways in (a person or an agent): each audience swaps in its own copyable line and actions, and a typed line (`typedLead` + `typedWords`) loops under them; the switch block loads on demand, only when `audiences` is set.
useWhen: Use ClosingCallToActionSection for the last band before the site footer that asks for one action, with links or a command.
Rendering page JSON, or you need a whole band with no custom content → this section. Building an SFC by hand, needing slots, or nesting inside another band → the `call-to-action` primitive.
In `primary` with `audiences`, to close a page whose reader may be a person or an agent, each with its own way in.
To close a solution or product page on its one or two asks, or a page such as Careers on one action (`panel`), or a page that ends on its one loud ask (`primary`).
avoidWhen: For a newsletter sign-up close → use `newsletter-section`.
For a close that lists deployable templates → use `template-gallery-section` with `closing`.
For an ask in the middle of a page → compose `call-to-action` directly.
related: `call-to-action` — the framed band this section renders.
`newsletter-section` — the closing band whose ask is a subscribe form.
`template-gallery-section` — with `closing`, the closing band that lists deployable templates.
bestPractices: Place it last on the page, right above `site-footer-section`, after a hatched `spacer`. It draws the hatched closing frame itself, so nothing follows it inside the page column: no trailing `Spacer` and no closing `RegistrationFrame` + `Texture` (the `shell/shell-site` close is for a page that ends on any other band). `azion-ui/no-gap-after-closing-section` flags the doubled close.
Set `anchor: 'contact'` so the page's contact links scroll to the close.
Use `variant: 'frame'` (no copy) to close a page that ends on a band with its own actions (a listing, a legal page); `site-page` draws no gap before it.
Turn `hatch` off only on a closing band that another closing band follows directly; the last one keeps the frame.
Give `command` a short shell line (`npm create azion@latest`); it is copied as written and reads as a command, with the `$` prompt.

Give `audiences` two or more entries so the switch renders; set `audiencesAriaLabel` and `lineAriaLabel` so the switch and the copyable field are named. With `audiences` set, `description` is the closing sentence under the typed line, and `command` and the two actions are not drawn.
Mark a command line with `copy.shell` so it draws the `$` prompt; leave a prompt meant for an agent bare.
Keep `title` to one short line; `primary` does not draw `eyebrow`.

props.name: variant
props.doc: Layout of the band: `panel` is one surface over a short closing frame, `primary` a centred ask under a pixelated texture over a tall closing frame, `frame` the tall closing frame alone.

props.name: anchor
props.doc: In-page id set on the band so a `#hash` link can scroll to it.

props.name: eyebrow
props.doc: Short overline above the headline; not drawn in `primary`.

props.name: title
props.doc: Headline of the band, rendered by the call to action as its `h2`; the band renders nothing when empty.

props.name: primaryAction
props.doc: The white button of the band, under the headline; `{ label, href, trailing? }` where `trailing` adds the chevron. Omitted when absent.

props.name: secondaryAction
props.doc: The outlined button of the band, beside the primary one; `{ label, href, trailing? }`. Omitted when absent.

props.name: command
props.doc: Shell command on a copyable line before the actions, copied as written; drawn in `panel` and `primary`.

props.name: hatch
props.doc: Draws the hatched closing frame under the band; turn it off when another closing band stacks directly below and draws the shared frame.

props.name: audiences
props.doc: The ways in of the `primary` close, in switch order; each is `{ value, label, copy?, actions? }` (`copy` is `{ label, text, shell? }`, `shell` drawing the `$` prompt; an action is `{ label, href, variant?, trailing? }`) and the first one opens. Replaces the command and the two actions; the switch renders only with two or more.

props.name: typedLead
props.doc: Fixed opening of the typed line under the audiences, before the typed word.

props.name: typedWords
props.doc: Words typed, held, erased and typed again in order after `typedLead`; the typed line renders only with `audiences` and words.

props.name: audiencesAriaLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the audience switch.

props.name: lineAriaLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the read-only field that shows an audience's copyable line.
